Not a fan of the new revamp. I’m a big fan of ddpy and have been a big fan of the app. The original one anyway. They recently revamped the app and I have to say, not a fan. Their updates made it so you can’t play music during the workout. I reached out about it and they said they are working on it, but didn’t seem to have high hopes of fixing it. 
The new workout video setup is a adhd sensory nightmare. I the preferred original set up and being able to put the work in and not worry about how many calories I’ve burned or how much time was left on the clock. I was able to focus more on the feel of the workout and get a good pump in. Now it’s all up in my face and it makes it difficult to lock in and focus and that’s a frustrating thing to me. 
I get changing things up and trying to improve upon things. But it my opinion the app wasn’t broke to begin with. So why try to fix it. 
I love this app but gotta say this revamp is an overcrowded downgrade for me.

Second, I returned to the app a year later, focused on staying 10-20 seconds ahead of the transitions so that I wouldn’t be rushed. I noticed that his weekly videos meant to inspire you hadn’t been updated in years. The weekly motivational videos feel dated.

Third, determined to push through, and feeling a bit pressured in the community do every day, and DDP’s insistence that if you don’t push yourself than you are lazy and weak, I jumped in everyday, beginner workout, and around day 48 I started to feel horrible pain in my stomach and very sick. It turns out that I gave myself an umbilical hernia, an inoperable umbilical hernia. I am now forbidden by doctors to do any yoga, any core work, and my daily life is filled with pain.

So here I am, dealing with two rare diseases that left me 150 pounds overweight, and now I have an umbilical hernia that cannot be operated on unless it ruptures, and then I’m 70-30 to surviving the surgery.

Don’t let the people on this app bully you into pushing too hard, nor the people in the community, and don’t be fooled by the idea that DDP actually cares about everyone who uses the app.
